cases.title: 配置来源：覆盖顺序和旧版迁移
command: loads explicit file and content overrides in priority order|loads opencode JSON and JSONC files from lowest to highest priority|migrates v1 configuration when a v1-only key is present
cases.observation: 通过原版读取器验证较高优先级来源与旧版配置迁移。

cases.title: Skill：挂到所属的用户消息
command: materializes mentioned skills on their owning prompt|refuses blocked skill mentions|publishes raw standalone content
cases.observation: 同一用户消息两处 Skill 引用保留定位，只物化一份正文。权限拒绝时不写入正文。

cases.title: 插件激活、失败隔离和卸载
command: reports a failed plugin without blocking a healthy plugin|unloading a plugin removes its commands|reloading a plugin replaces its command implementation
cases.observation: 原版注册表观察失败隔离、命令替换和卸载清理。

cases.title: 插件更新文件损坏
command: keeps the running generation when an updated local plugin fails to import
cases.observation: 更新的本地模块导入失败时，旧的一代插件继续服务。

cases.title: 调用前 Hook：输入修复后再过 schema
command: repairs tool input before validating its original schema|repairs nested Code Mode calls
cases.observation: 观察修复结果进入真实工具执行器，并验证嵌套调用的参数 schema。

cases.title: MCP 两条调用路径和权限
command: forwards the invoking session through direct and Code Mode MCP tools|waits for permission before calling an MCP tool|does not call MCP when permission is blocked
cases.observation: 直接工具与 Code Mode 调用携带自己的 Session 来源，受拒绝的操作不发往 MCP。

cases.title: MCP 动态能力、资源和事件
command: refreshes the top connection's tools when it reports a change
cases.observation: 测试 MCP 连接发出工具目录变化，原版 Location 注册表重新刷新。

cases.title: 推送事件要先经过权限
command: lists one server's push events after asking permission
cases.observation: 原版工具先向权限服务询问，再返回 MCP 事件目录。

cases.title: CLI 路由：本地命令与 Server 连接
cases.observation: 验证全局连接参数和本地命令的无 Server 路径。

cases.title: SDK 嵌入式路由与事件取消
command: Promise host uses the embedded router|Promise event streams support cancellation
cases.observation: 通过进程内路由走共享 API，并验证事件订阅可取消。

cases.title: SSE 分片、UTF-8 与 heartbeat
command: event.subscribe parses split JSON and a split multibyte code point|event.subscribe ignores server heartbeat comments
cases.observation: 客户端按 SSE 边界组帧，兼容跨数据块的字符和心跳注释。

cases.title: 重连后不期待易失事件流重放
command: a reconnect does not ask the volatile event stream to replay
cases.observation: 重连重新订阅实时事件，客户端状态恢复通过读取模型数据实现。

cases.title: SSE 服务端订阅与慢消费者
command: encodes once and delivers|fails only the subscriber that exceeds its lag capacity|filters internal events
cases.observation: 共享序列化帧、按订阅分隔背压和过滤内部事件。

cases.title: 实验 API 路径与 OpenAPI 标识一致
command: routes under /api/experimental, and only those, have experimental
cases.observation: 执行原版 CI 相关断言，验证 experimental 路径和操作标识匹配。
